## Dungeons & Dragons Challenge Ratings

Do third-party publishers assign challenge ratings consistently with official D&D monsters that have similar stats? This project uses monster data from the Open5e API to explore that question.

- [Project code and README](https://github.com/AndrewGivens/dnd-challenge-rating-analysis)
- [Blog post](dnd-challenge-ratings.qmd)
